phone.description:
Optional filter by phone number.

Searches across HomePhone, WorkPhone, and CellPhone fields using an OR condition.
If the phone number is found in any of these three fields, the contact is included in results.
Phone input is normalized into 4 standard formats for flexible matching:
- Digits only (e.g., 1234567890)
- Area code in parens (e.g., (123)4567890)
- Standard format (e.g., (123) 456-7890)
- Dashes only (e.g., 123-456-7890)
phone.title: Phone
